evidence_sentence: It also reads property info based on the section declaration offset.
rationale: The fixed implementation delegates property parsing to cdf_read_property_info using the declared section offset, CDF_TOLE4(sd->sd_offset). The vulnerable implementation instead iterates according to the summary-info count and does not show use of the section declaration's sd_offset for property parsing. The docstring therefore describes the fixed offset-based parsing behavior, although the phrase has some residual ambiguity because both versions reference the section-declaration structure.
rewritten_docstring: The function checks the validity of stream offsets, retrieves summary information, and populates the provided structures with the byte order, OS version, OS type, class, and property information count. It also reads property information from the stream.
